Public component-simulation notebooks are an OrPen SC PDK interface. SCGSim
owns their reusable runtime APIs and keeps no duplicate notebook source.
The [course map](examples.qmd#public-inputs) links the canonical public sources.

## Stage-local controls

Only workflow action, run ID and run root are global consumer controls.
Component inputs, physics assumptions, mesh, config, resources and analysis
selections belong beside their immediate actions. The visible sequence is
source → model/EPR → mesh where applicable → config/handoff → explicit host
execution → returned-run analysis. Backend setup stays visible; package-owned
handoff, Desktop ownership, readback, hashes and resolution do not become
notebook-local helper implementations.

Source summaries precede preparation. Returned analysis starts with identity,
numerical evidence and cost before physics. The [report contract](report-model.qmd)
owns ordering/availability; [execution profiles](execution-profiles.qmd) own
scripts/resources/return identity; backend contracts own controls. The notebook
must not turn an incomplete receipt or unreadable final table into success.

## Source and result custody

PDK materials/fabrication and component local semantics remain with their owners.
The notebook assigns named occurrences and the final Net map through GeometryPlan.
Public notebooks contain no private geometry, selectors, dimensions, screenshots,
configs, meshes, receipts or artifacts. Ignoring an artifact directory in Git
does not preserve its bytes for later resolution; the study owner must retain
its evidence. The [provenance contract](provenance.qmd) defines publication
boundaries. Runtime implementation does not grant notebook acceptance or native
solver accuracy.
